# HyprFlux Documentation

> HyprFlux is an Arch Linux desktop platform built around the Hyprland Wayland compositor. It is available as a bootable installation ISO and as a full desktop provisioner for an existing Arch Linux system.

## Current Documentation Baseline

- HyprFlux release documented: 1.5.0
- Source revision: 0f62647d95178eefa7cf8cd1b66760e93a260ef7
- Canonical website: https://www.hyprflux.dev
- Source repository: https://github.com/ahmad9059/HyprFlux
- Canonical releases: https://github.com/ahmad9059/HyprFlux/releases/latest
- v1.5.0 release note: https://www.hyprflux.dev/blog/release-v1.5.0

## Installation Paths

- Choose a path: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/quickstart
- Download and verify the ISO: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/download
- Install from the ISO: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/iso-installation
- Provision an existing Arch system: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/installation

The existing-Arch path performs full provisioning. It is not a configuration-only dotfiles copy.

## Operations

- Hardware and generated state: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/hardware
- Troubleshooting: https://www.hyprflux.dev/general/troubleshooting
- Hyprland shortcuts: https://www.hyprflux.dev/keybindings/hyprland
- Managed scripts and utilities: https://www.hyprflux.dev/hyprland/scripts

## Configuration And Components

- Hyprland Lua architecture: https://www.hyprflux.dev/hyprland/
- Hyprland user experience: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/hyprland
- Waybar: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/waybar
- Rofi: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/rofi
- SwayNC: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/swaync
- Hyprlock: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/hyprlock
- Wallpapers and AWWW: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/wallpapers
- Kitty: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/kitty
- Neovim: https://www.hyprflux.dev/features/nvim

Hyprland 0.55+ configuration is Lua-only in current HyprFlux. Hyprlock, Hypridle, and application-style configuration legitimately remain in their native `.conf` formats.

## Historical Content

Pages under https://www.hyprflux.dev/blog/ are dated archive records. Use the current guides above for installation, downloads, and configuration.
